email.subject: Summit MOB — Level 2 floor protection
email.body:
Hi,

Ridgeline Drywall tore up the floor protection in the Level 2 west corridor at Summit while moving board. We had the laborers replace it this morning. I'm estimating about $680 for labor and material until the tickets come in.

Please open a back-charge for Ridgeline Drywall and note that the number is an estimate for now.

Thanks,
Dana
